title: UFC Scoreboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the UFC Scoreboard plugin - displays live, recent, and upcoming UFC fights with fighter headshots, records, and odds. Based on original work by Alex Resnick (legoguy1000).

enabled.description: Enable or disable the UFC scoreboard plugin

display_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the display controller to show this plugin mode before rotating to next plugin

update_interval.description: How often to fetch new data in seconds

game_display_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each individual fight before rotating to the next fight within the same mode

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to display event start times (e.g. America/Chicago). Leave blank to follow the LEDMatrix global timezone, or the system timezone if none is set.

favorite_fighters.description: List of favorite fighter full names (e.g., 'Islam Makhachev', 'Jon Jones')

favorite_weight_classes.description: List of favorite weight class abbreviations (e.g., 'LW', 'HW', 'WW', 'MW', 'FW', 'BW', 'FLW', 'LHW', 'WSW', 'WFW', 'WBW', 'WFLW')

display_modes.title: Display Modes
display_modes.description: Control which fight types to show and how they display

live_display_mode.description: Display mode for live fights: 'switch' rotates fights one at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all fights horizontally

scroll_settings.title: Scroll Settings
scroll_settings.description: Settings for scroll display mode (when display mode is set to 'scroll')

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second (default: 50). Higher values scroll faster.

scroll_delay.description: Delay between scroll frames in seconds (default: 0.01 = 100 FPS). Lower values = smoother scrolling.

gap_between_games.description: Gap in pixels between fight cards when scrolling

show_league_separators.description: Show league icons between different leagues

dynamic_duration.description: Automatically calculate display duration based on content width

game_card_width.description: Width of each fight card in scroll mode (pixels). Default 128. Set lower on multi-panel chains to show more fights simultaneously.

live_priority.description: Give live fights priority over other modes. When enabled, live fights will interrupt the normal mode rotation and be displayed immediately when available.

live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each live fight before rotating to the next live fight

recent_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each recent fight before rotating. Falls back to game_display_duration if not set.

upcoming_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each upcoming fight before rotating. Falls back to game_display_duration if not set.

live_update_interval.description: How often to update live fight data (seconds)

game_limits.title: Fight Limits
game_limits.description: Control how many fights to show

recent_games_to_show.description: Number of recent fights to display. With favorites: N per favorite fighter. Without favorites: N total.

upcoming_games_to_show.description: Number of upcoming fights to display. With favorites: N per favorite fighter. Without favorites: N total.

other_upcoming_games_to_show.title: Other upcoming games to show
other_upcoming_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite upcoming games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Your favorites are shown first, then this many other games. Set to 0 to show only your favorites. Ignored when 'Show favorite teams only' is on, or when no favorite teams are set.

other_recent_games_to_show.title: Other recent games to show
other_recent_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite recent games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Set to 0 to show only your favorites.

other_rotation_interval_seconds.title: Rotate other games every (seconds)
other_rotation_interval_seconds.description: How often (seconds) to advance the window of NON-favorite games, so the board works through the schedule over time instead of showing the same handful. Variety comes from this turnover rather than from a larger selection: a bigger selection makes a full cycle longer, which makes any given game appear less often. Set to 0 to keep a fixed selection. Only applies when favorite teams are set and 'Show favorite teams only' is off.

other_games_min_quality.title: Which other games to show
other_games_min_quality.description: Which NON-favorite games are worth a slot. 'ranked' shows only games involving a nationally ranked team; 'broadcast' also allows games with a national TV listing; 'any' is the old behaviour of whatever comes next chronologically. Your favorite teams are never filtered by this. A league with no national poll has nothing to rank against, so 'ranked' lets everything through there rather than emptying the slots, and the same goes for 'broadcast' in a league ESPN publishes no TV listings for.

other_games_divisions.title: Divisions to include (other games)
other_games_divisions.description: Which divisions the NON-favorite games may come from. At least one team has to be in a checked division, so with only FBS checked you still see a ranked FBS team hosting an FCS school, but two FCS teams playing each other are left out. Check FCS or Other to bring those in as well. Your favorite teams are never filtered by this, so a team from any division still always appears. FBS/FCS is a college FOOTBALL taxonomy and ESPN publishes those rosters for that league alone, so this setting does nothing in any other league -- no lookup is even attempted.

display_options.title: Display Options
display_options.description: Additional information to show on fight cards

show_fighter_names.description: Show fighter short names near headshots

show_fight_class.description: Show weight class abbreviation (e.g., LW, HW)

show_favorite_fighters_only.description: Only show fights involving favorite fighters or weight classes

show_all_live.description: Show all live fights regardless of favorites

dynamic_duration.title: Dynamic Duration Settings
dynamic_duration.description: Configure dynamic duration settings for UFC fights. When enabled, the display duration adapts based on the number of available fights.

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for UFC fights

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum total duration in seconds, even if few fights are available

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum total duration in seconds, even if many fights are available

modes.title: Per-Mode Settings
modes.description: Configure dynamic duration for specific modes

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for live fights
Enable dynamic duration for recent fights
Enable dynamic duration for upcoming fights

customization.title: Display Customization
customization.description: Customize fonts and element positioning for fight card display

font.description: Font file path for fighter names
Font file path for round/status text
Font file path for fight result
Font file path for detail text (odds, records, etc.)

layout.title: Layout Positioning
layout.description: Adjust X,Y coordinate offsets for elements. Values are relative to default positions. Use negative values to move left/up, positive to move right/down.

fighter1_x_offset.description: Fighter 1 record horizontal offset from right (default: 0)

fighter2_x_offset.description: Fighter 2 record horizontal offset from left (default: 0)

fighter1_x_offset.description: Fighter 1 name horizontal offset from right (default: 0)

fighter2_x_offset.description: Fighter 2 name horizontal offset from left (default: 0)

schedule_lookback_days.title: Schedule lookback (days)
schedule_lookback_days.description: How far back to fetch games for the Recent screen. Raise it if finished games disappear sooner than you want.

schedule_lookahead_days.title: Schedule lookahead (days)
schedule_lookahead_days.description: How far ahead to fetch games for the Upcoming screen. Raise it for a league that plays weekly: a fixture just beyond this horizon is not fetched at all, so it never reaches the board even though the date is known.

no_data_interval_seconds.title: Idle live-check interval (seconds)
no_data_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait between checks for live games when there are none. Backs off further the longer nothing is found, up to the cap below.

live_idle_max_interval_seconds.title: Maximum idle live-check interval (seconds)
live_idle_max_interval_seconds.description: Ceiling for the back-off above. Raise it to poll an out-of-season league even less; lower it to notice the first game after a quiet spell sooner.
